FN-U8JMDG-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 90
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Senator Steve Livingston
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/05/2023
Senate Bill 90 as passed the Senate would exclude medical cannabis from the producer value
added sales tax exemption. As no such products have been sold in the state to date, this bill
would not directly affect state or local funding.
